description: Files an order through the same door as the web order form and returns {order_token, status, checkout_url}. status is one of: awaiting_payment: Instant pay: finish checkout at checkout_url. Nothing runs before payment. Work begins at our analyst's go-ahead.; awaiting_scope_review: An analyst confirms scope with the buyer first, then sends the payment link or an invoice. Nothing is charged until then.; awaiting_human_approval: An order filed before 2026-11-04 from an agent operator we had not approved yet: a person approves it before any checkout link. Nothing is charged until then. checkout_url is set only for awaiting_payment. This tool never charges, never starts a report and never releases one. Requires the buyer's consent and paid-engagement acknowledgment, ai_agent_name and agent_operator.

agent_operator.description: The organisation that runs the agent. A person checks the first order from an operator before its report is released.

asking_price.description: The asking price, where the report reads one (Property Screen, Housing Screen).

consent.description: true: the buyer accepts the Privacy Policy and the SMS terms. Required.

email.description: The buyer's email. The one confirmation and the report go here; it must be a deliverable address.

geography.description: ONE place. kind=address: {address}; kind=zip: {zip}; kind=county: {state, county_fips}; kind=parcel: {state, county_fips, parcel_id}; kind=pin: {lat, lng} (saved as coordinates, never turned into an address).

min_acres.description: Minimum lot size in acres; the search applies it as the floor, unless it is also posted as a nice-to-have chip (emphasis only).

must.description: Must-have chips for the ring searches (Tower Sheet, Site Search): the catalog's hunt_chips keys; min_acres posts as min_acres=<n>.

nice.description: Nice-to-have chips, same keys. Emphasis only; they filter nothing.

notes.description: Anything the analyst should read; longer text is cut at 4,000 characters. Read by a person; it changes nothing automatically.

on_behalf_of.description: The principal the agent orders for: a name, or {name, organization, email}.

paid_ack.description: true: the buyer acknowledges, verbatim: “I understand this is a paid engagement. After payment, an ARUON analyst checks the order and starts the report; the clock starts at our analyst's go-ahead, not at the card charge.” Required.

radius_mi.description: Search radius in whole miles, 1–100, for the ring searches. Blank is the default ring.

site_acres.description: Site size the buyer needs, in acres (read by the analyst).

sku.description: The report, by its catalog key (list_products / pricing.json).

use.description: Intended use, for the SKUs that read one (Property Screen, Tower Sheet, Site Search).

name: create_order
title: Place an order (nothing is charged here)
